contract.sampling_unit: one routed decision per generated instance; instances are i.i.d. draws of the seeded generator, so units are exchangeable by construction
contract.evidence_score: s(rule) = (n_majority + 1) / (n_leaf + 2), Laplace-shrunk consistency of the induced rule (decision-tree leaf) on the induction sample; a property of the rule that fired, constant within a rule, monotone in support and consistency; never recomputed after induction
contract.routing: the single tree leaf the instance falls in; committed output is the leaf majority expert label
contract.gold: executable policy gold(X, u) in cus/envs/claims.py, deterministic in the instance (manifest X plus latent u); u is stored with the instance so gold is mechanically recomputable, and u is never a covariate
contract.induction: n_demo = 6000 demonstrations drawn once from SeedSequence [20260818, 0]; expert labels are gold flipped with probability 0.06; DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=7, min_samples_leaf=40, random_state=0) fitted on the INDUCTION VIEW, the 12 manifest features excluding inconsistency (the demonstration log never recorded it); induction data are split 1 of the four-way protocol and are never touched again
contract.shift: rung 2: exponential tilt exp(beta * phi(x)) on a registered bounded feature, sampled exactly by rejection from fresh generator draws; unnormalised ratio exact by construction; chi2 estimated by Monte Carlo with reported SE

gate_thresholds.G1_solvability: >= 0.98 deterministic and well-defined gold on 50000 fresh instances
gate_thresholds.G2_fidelity: rejection draws match importance-weighted source moments within 5 combined MC SE for every tilt feature at beta = 5
gate_thresholds.G3_blindness: decision-conditional held-out AUC lift of wrong ~ (s, dec, x_j, dec*x_j) over wrong ~ (s, dec) of at least 0.02 for at least one registered tilt feature; audit published either way
gate_thresholds.G4_region_mass: region-1 share >= 0.05 at every beta in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} on the primary tilt feature
gate_thresholds.G5_spread: induced rule scores occupy >= 20 cells of the 400-point lambda grid

notes: Environment design was iterated on generator parameters BEFORE this freeze (difficulty, region cut, expert noise); the freeze marks the point after which any change to cus/envs/claims.py generator, gold, induction parameters, contract fields, or gate thresholds requires an appended amendment here. Gate outcomes are appended under a dated gates key after the gate run.

amendments.what: Gate 3 FAILED at first freeze (best held-out AUC lift +0.0072 vs threshold 0.02; audit archived at artifacts/gates_claims_36bc9577ed644af7 and published in docs/gates/claims.md). Redesign: the induction view excludes inconsistency, so no induced rule and hence no evidence score can condition on it, while gold still depends on it; primary tilt feature moved from severity to inconsistency; severity retained as the evidence-visible candidate for the tilt-location ablation. New gate config hash 2ce3e00aea6b6b19.
amendments.why: With all manifest features visible to induction, depth-7 rules absorbed nearly all the X-dependence of wrongness, so the environment could not exhibit the evidence-blind failure WP1 measures. The redesign is the programme's own stated phenomenon (evidence is a property of the rule; some case features are invisible to it, e.g. attributes the demonstration log never recorded), made explicit in the environment rather than left to emergence.

amendments.what: Gate 3 failed again after amendment 1 (unsigned lift +0.0049 for inconsistency), and an offline design check showed unweighted CRC SELF-CORRECTING under the inconsistency tilt (risk falling to 0.091 at beta 5): auto_flag leaked inconsistency into the induction view (coefficient 0.5), routing high-inconsistency mass into low-purity, low-s leaves that defer by themselves. Three changes: (a) auto_flag now depends on severity (rule-visible) instead of inconsistency; inconsistency segment mixtures flattened, removing the proxy leak; (b) gold strengthened on the blind feature (inconsistency 1.6 to 2.6, interaction 1.2 to 2.0, intercept retuned to keep the wrong rate near 0.135); (c) the G3 audit is now decision-conditional, wrong ~ (s, dec) + (x_j, dec*x_j), threshold unchanged at 0.02, and the gate beta grid extends to 6. New gate config hash recorded above.
amendments.why: The unsigned audit provably cancels sign-opposed conditional effects: on identical data the unsigned lift for inconsistency was +0.0049 and the decision-conditional lift +0.0627 (corr(inc, wrong) = +0.29 in APPROVE-routed cases, -0.45 in INVESTIGATE-routed). The routed decision is available before commitment, so conditioning on it is legitimate. The proxy leak reproduced synth v1's self-correction disease through a realistic mechanism; decoupling restores the evidence-blind regime the programme studies (post-redesign offline check: unweighted risk rises 0.095 to 0.128 across beta 0 to 6, chi2 0 to 3.47).

gates.G2: all tilt features pass at beta=6, worst moment diff 0.13 of tolerance
